# Schoolio / Sekolah Pintar AI Handoff

Schoolio is an Indonesian-first, multi-tenant school management web app. It uses Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. The tenant boundary is `SchoolProfile.id`.

## Start Here

Read these files before doing any project work:

1. `docs/PLANS.md` - canonical roadmap, architecture, conventions, backlog, and open decisions.
2. `docs/build_logs.md` - chronological AI work log and handoff trail.
3. `prisma/schema.prisma` - domain models, enums, and relations.
4. `lib/api.ts` - `requireAuth`, `requireRole`, `requireSchoolContext`, `parseJsonBody`, `jsonOk`, `jsonError`.
5. `lib/authz.ts` - RBAC and ownership helpers.
6. `lib/schemas.ts` - shared Zod schemas. Add schemas here instead of inlining them.
7. `middleware.ts` - auth gating, onboarding gating, must-change-password gating, CSRF enforcement, correlation ID.

For feature work, also read the matching route, handler, and page/component files:

- `app/api/<feature>/route.ts`
- `lib/handlers/<feature>.ts`
- `components/pages/<Feature>.tsx`

## Mandatory Engineering Rules

- Keep `docs/PLANS.md` as the canonical source of truth. This file is only a fast entrypoint.
- After every AI-implemented task, append a concise entry to `docs/build_logs.md`.
- Always derive actor-owned IDs such as `authorId`, `studentId`, `teacherId`, and `userId` from the authenticated actor, not from request bodies.
- Every protected route starts with `requireAuth(request)`.
- Never bypass `requireSchoolContext(actor)` for tenant-scoped data.
- Every Prisma query must be scoped by `schoolId` directly or through a tenant-scoped parent relation.
- Put request/response validation schemas in `lib/schemas.ts`.
- Keep route handlers thin: auth, role check, school context, ownership check, validation, handler call, response.
- Put business logic in `lib/handlers/<feature>.ts`.
- Return API responses with `jsonOk(data)` or `jsonError(code, message, status)`.
- Browser unsafe API requests must include the double-submit CSRF token from `schoolio_csrf` as `X-CSRF-Token`; use `lib/api-client.ts` helpers.
- Use existing shadcn/Radix UI components under `components/ui/`; do not introduce an alternate UI library.
- Use Indonesian conventional commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `chore:`.

## Common Commands

```bash
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run lint
npm run test
npm run test:watch
npm run prisma:generate
npm run prisma:migrate
npm run prisma:studio
npm run academic-year:rollover
```

## Current Release Focus

Follow `docs/PLANS.md` Section 11 and Section 12. The P0/P1 release-hardening items completed so far include reset-token invalidation, tenant-scoped authz fixes, rate limiting, CSRF, audit logging, schedule clash enforcement, attendance session uniqueness, forum lock enforcement, email notification delivery, and a green production build. Current release focus is school usability: manual smoke, role dashboards, empty states, error boundaries, setup/readiness docs, and flows needed by real school staff. Upload scanner provider integration and distributed SaaS rate limits remain tracked security hardening, but are intentionally deferred until after the school-usability release.
